entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Dominarian religion that feared and hated magic and artifice.

entities.name: Tal
entities.description: Ancient Yotian sun god worshipped by the Church.

entities.name: Raddic of Kroog
entities.description: Leader of the Talite crusade, killed at Mishra's forge.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: Destruction after which people turned to religion.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: Group whose fall the Church partly caused.

events.summary: Two Yotian sun-worshipping cults join to form the Church after the Sylex Blast.
events.quote: The Church formed when two Yotian sun-worshipping cults joined.

events.summary: Raddic's Talites destroy the Monastery of Gix and begin their crusade.
events.quote: After destroying the Monastery of Gix

events.summary: The Talites fail in the Siege of Penregon.
events.quote: they began the unsuccessful Siege of Penregon in the spring of 69 AR

events.summary: Raddic is killed at Mishra's forge.
events.quote: followed by Mishra 's forge, where Raddic was killed

events.summary: Church holds the city-states in an iron grip by 430 AR.
events.quote: By 430 AR, Tal had an iron grip on the city-states of the era.

events.summary: Church prayers are found to be white spells and tolerance of mages grows.
events.quote: greater tolerance of magic users was fostered by this knowledge

relations.quote: The Talites, led by Raddic of Kroog
devoted to worshiping an ancient sun god
The Church of Tal was partially responsible for the Fall of the Conclave of Mages
